subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

GAVE ∶ AGEV ∶∶ KEPT ∶ EKTP ∶∶ ACID ∶ ?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] The logic followed here is : • First letter interchanged position with second letter. • Third letter interchanged position with fourth letter. So, • GAVE ∶ AGEV
